title.zh: Release边界：JDV签核不是万能验证
title.en: Release limits: JDV sign-off is not universal validation

subtitle.zh: JDV确认光罩数据，但不能替代设计与工艺验证。
subtitle.en: JDV confirms mask data; it cannot replace design and process validation

heading.en: What sign-off confirms and cannot replace

body.zh: JDV签核可以确认；写版视图内容；Mask层与Frame完整性；Tone与几何变换；版本与Issue状态
body.en: JDV sign-off can confirm Mask-writing view contents Completeness of mask layers and frame Tone and geometric transformations Version and issue status

body.zh: JDV签核不能替代；DRC / LVS；设计功能验证；Mask Inspection；Wafer工艺与电性验证
body.en: JDV sign-off cannot replace DRC / LVS Design-function validation Mask inspection Wafer process and electrical validation

body.zh: 确认数据；≠ 保证最终芯片成功
关键控制；签核范围；授权角色；最终Revision；Audit Trail
body.en: Key controls Sign-off scope Authorized roles Final revision Audit trail

body.zh: 进度与风险；赶Release可；缩短排程，；但未关闭异常会；放大制造风险
body.en: Schedule and risk Rushing release can shorten the schedule, but unresolved anomalies amplify manufacturing risk

body.zh: 签核人错误；版本不可追溯
Release记录；Release Record；File Hash；Sign-off Matrix；最终Issue清单
body.en: Release records Release record File hash Sign-off matrix Final issue list

body.zh: 边界：JDV签核不能替代DRC/LVS、功能验证、；Mask Inspection及Wafer验证。
body.en: Limit: JDV sign-off cannot replace DRC/LVS, functional validation, mask inspection or wafer validation
